component.name: Corvus
component.summary: Desktop client for Signal with an encrypted local chat history

description.p: Corvus is a native Qt 6 interface for signal-cli. Link it to your Signal account as an additional device and chat from your desktop.

ul.li: Read and send messages, including group chats, replies and reactions
Send and receive files, images, video and audio
Edit or delete messages, manage archived chats and disappearing messages
Desktop notifications, notification sounds and a tray icon
Encrypted local chat history, protected by the system keyring or a passphrase

description.p: This package includes signal-cli. Corvus is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with Signal.
